title: dryopteris laeta var. giraldii
intro: Dryopteris laeta var. giraldii, commonly known as Wood fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Wood fern include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and diuretic properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, joint pain, and urinary issues. Bioactive constituents present in Wood fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
